description: This source file defines the 'LinkAnnotations' class with a method to merge PDF documents by inserting pages and saving the result, focusing on handling link annotations within PDF files.

classes.name: LinkAnnotations
classes.description: Provides static methods for managing link annotations within PDF files, including merging documents.

methods.name: MergeDocumentsWithLinkAnnotations
methods.description: Merges two PDF documents by inserting pages from one into the other at specified positions and saves the resulting PDF to a temporary file.
